# hivemind_forager_org_service_integration (Resource)

An organization-wide Forager service integration. Forager's credential-injecting proxy adds `headers_wo` to requests sent to `target`, so sandboxes never see the real credentials. Requires a service account with the `manage` scope (and `read` for refresh).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "datadog_access_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

variable "datadog_token_version" {
  type    = string
  default = "1"
}

# Sandboxes get DD_SITE=<proxy host> and a placeholder token; the Forager
# proxy injects the real Datadog token, so agents never see it.
resource "hivemind_forager_org_service_integration" "datadog" {
  name    = "datadog"
  target  = "https://api.us5.datadoghq.com"
  methods = ["GET", "HEAD", "POST"]
  env = {
    DD_SITE         = "{proxy_host}"
    DD_ACCESS_TOKEN = "forager-proxy"
    PUP_TRUST_SITE  = "1"
  }
  headers_wo         = { Authorization = "Bearer ${var.datadog_access_token}" }
  headers_wo_version = var.datadog_token_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Integration name; also the proxy hostname label (e.g. `datadog`).

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `allowed_teams` (Set of String) `owner/team` slugs allowed to use the integration. Null grants every org member.
- `audience` (String) Audience for an OIDC integration. Omit when unused; an empty string is invalid.
- `default` (Boolean) Attach to environments that don't list integrations explicitly.
- `env` (Map of String) Environment variables set in sandboxes, e.g. `DD_SITE = "{proxy_host}"`.
- `headers_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Headers the proxy injects. Write-only: never stored in state. Every apply that updates this resource re-sends them; omitting them removes stored credentials.
- `headers_wo_version` (String) Change to force an update that re-sends `headers_wo` (e.g. after rotating a token).
- `kind` (String) Integration kind: `http` (default) or `oidc`.
- `methods` (List of String) Allowed HTTP methods. Defaults to GET and HEAD.
- `paths` (List of String) Allowed proxy paths. Defaults to the root path (/).
- `service_account` (String) Service account for an OIDC integration. Omit when unused.
- `target` (String) Upstream base URL, e.g. `https://api.us5.datadoghq.com`.
- `wif_provider` (String) Workload identity federation provider for an OIDC integration. Omit when unused.

### Read-Only

- `has_credentials` (Boolean) Whether the integration has stored credentials. Credential values are never returned.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `revision` (String) Server revision of the integration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by integration name, not by UUID.
terraform import hivemind_forager_org_service_integration.datadog datadog
```
